description:
FILED by the reviewing session (2026-11-28) at the merge of the Rosetta census A (s543p; docs/rosetta-plan.md section 6a), which keyed eleven SILENT programs on `NS:ns-regex-escapes`: `\K` never matches, each program's ONLY cause (a capture spelling runs identical to perl).  RULED IN (DECIDED s543, 2026-11-28): docs/supported-subset.md section 3 says `regexes within cl-ppcre's reach` and section 4 puts only code blocks, recursion and control verbs OUT; the row in docs/not-supported.md ns-regex-escapes is an AUDIT of escapes that silently never match ("rule 12's worst case"), not a ruling -- and `\K` is within reach by the rewriter that already translates `\h \R \X \p{}`.

THE SHAPE (the reviewing session's neutral probe, perl 5.40.3 vs main cababb9d = MAIN-READY-114):
    my $s = "foo=bar; baz=qux";
    (my $t = $s) =~ s/foo=\Kbar/X/;   print "1 $t\n";       # perl 1 foo=X; baz=qux      PCL 1 foo=bar; baz=qux
    (my $u = $s) =~ s/\w+=\K\w+/V/g; print "2 $u\n";       # perl 2 foo=V; baz=V        PCL unchanged
    if ($s =~ /foo=\Kbar/) { print "3 [$&] pre[$`] post[$'] $-[0] $+[0]\n" }   # perl 3 [bar] pre[foo=] post[; baz=qux] 4 7    PCL no match
    my @all = $s =~ /=\K(\w+)/g;       # perl bar qux   PCL ()
    my @w   = $s =~ /=\K\w+/g;         # perl bar qux   PCL ()
    print join("|", split /a\Kz|;\K /, $s);   # perl foo=bar;|ba|=qux   PCL the whole string
    my $v = "aXbXc"; print $v =~ s/X\K(?=b)/-/r;   # perl aX-bXc (a zero-length keep)   PCL aXbXc
    my $g = "x1y2";  $g =~ /(?<=x)1\Ky(\d)/;      # perl $& = y2, $1 = 2             PCL no match

SEMANTICS (perlre): `\K` keeps what was matched before it OUT of $& -- the match's reported START moves to the `\K` position ($&, $`, @-[0], the span a substitution replaces, what a list-context /g match without groups returns, the separator `split` removes); capture groups and their numbering are untouched; under /g the next step still starts at the match's END.  With several `\K` the last one EXECUTED on the successful path decides.

WHERE: cl/pcl-runtime.lisp, the escape rewriter `%pcl-rewrite-scan` (docs/not-supported.md ns-regex-escapes lists its dispatch) has no arm for `\K`; cl-ppcre has no keep operator.  A DIRECTION, not designed: the rewriter plants a marker (an empty group whose register records the keep position, hidden from the program's $N / @- / @+ numbering) and every consumer of the match START reads it -- the consumers are the thing to count first (match, s///, s///g, /r, list-context //g, split, pos, $& $` @-, named captures' numbering, tr is not one).

THE CHEAP DISCRIMINATING MEASUREMENT (not taken): how many places in the runtime read a match's start register 0 -- if they all go through ONE accessor the marker is a small change; if not, that accessor is the first step.

=== s543q (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-28, CODE 6a1301ed) ===
FOUR MORE ROSETTA PROGRAMS hold `\K` (census B: their FIRST complaint is another cause; `\K` is the second or third cause of each, confirmed by patching the other causes first and then the `\K` substitution -- each program is byte-identical to perl only when the `\K` site is rewritten too):
  0119-Bifid-cipher, 0649-Inconsummate-numbers-in-base-10, 0710-Klarner-Rado-sequence -- a table formatter `s/.{1,$t}\K/\n/gr` (the same helper in three programs);
  0266-Consistent-overhead-byte-stuffing -- `s!(\w\w)\K(( \1){7,})! ... !ger` (`\K` after a backreference group, with /e); here `\K` is the ONLY stdout cause (its NOTICE is #3414's `local` shape, stdout unaffected).
Neutral reproducer, run on the tree:
    my $s = "abcdefgh";
    print $s =~ s/.{1,3}\K/-/gr, "\n";
    print $s =~ s/.{3}\K/-/gr, "\n";
    perl: abc-def-gh-
          abc-def-gh
    PCL : abcdefgh
          abcdefgh
subject: SILENT WRONG: `\K` (keep) in a pattern NEVER MATCHES -- `s/foo=\Kbar/X/` leaves the string, `/=\K\w+/g` returns nothing; the escape is handed to cl-ppcre untranslated (11 Rosetta programs: the largest single cause of the census)
triage_reason: the reviewing session, 2026-11-28: a regex escape within the rewriter's reach (docs/supported-subset.md section 3); silently never matching today
